__broaden__.ለብሔረ: ብሔር — to the land of (ለ- 'to, for' + construct) · upon (ለ- marking the place shone upon: አብርሀት ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'she shone upon the land of Ethiopia')
__broaden__.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
__broaden__.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition) · conjunction 'until' before a subjunctive (እስከ ይትፌጸም 'until might be fulfilled')
__broaden__.ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?)
__broaden__.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
__broaden__.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
